digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion registration and guide generation
propositions: The T15 overlay-derisk criterion rubric must be written verbatim into src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T15.md with front-matter execution_mode set to the prompt-loader enum value 'agentic' (not the routing exec value 'AGENT')
The T15 routing entry in criteria_routing.json must specify exec='AGENT', facet='overlay-derisk', overlay_routing='llm', and applies_at with suppress_types=['bug']
T15 must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM within registry.py and pass all registry validators (check_registry_coverage, validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide)
The regenerated plan-review-criteria-guide.md must contain the full T15 section with all four checks (RISK NAMED, FAST OUT-OF-LOOP PROOF, PROVE-THEN-CODIFY, SCOPED CLEANUP) verbatim
The 'rebar explain T15' command must display the criterion name, exec tier AGENT, facet overlay-derisk, and the complete rubric body including S1-S3 gates and checks a-d
